## User story

As an operator running ..., I want ..., so that ....

## Problem statement

What problem are you trying to solve? Why is the current behavior insufficient?

## Proposed solution

What would you like to see? Describe the user-visible behavior, the CRD or API surface (if any), and how it interacts with existing concepts. Reference existing documentation where relevant.

## Alternatives considered

What other ways could this problem be solved? Why did you prefer the proposed solution?

## Additional context

Anything else that helps us understand the feature.

---

For substantial features (new CRDs, new CRD fields, new API endpoints, new engines), please open a Discussion first and consider whether an [RFC](../../docs/rfcs/README.md) is warranted. The maintainers will help guide non-trivial proposals from issue to RFC to implementation.
